_note: AI-drafted Call to Worship — pending Wilson's curation.

registers.label: Spare
lines: A bruised reed he will not break.
He will faithfully bring forth justice.
Mary poured out the ointment, and the house filled with its scent.
In your light, O Lord, we see light.
The fountain of life is with you.
Do not be far from us, O Lord.
Come, let us worship the servant on his way.
Do not be far from us, O Lord. Amen.

registers.label: Immersive
lines: A jar breaks open, and the whole house fills with the scent of pure nard, costly and poured out without counting the cost.
Do not be far from us, O Lord.
Mary kneels and wipes his feet with her hair, loving him toward the grave while there is still time to love him.
Do not be far from us, O Lord.
This is the servant Isaiah saw: a bruised reed he will not break, a dim wick he will not snuff out, justice carried gently to the nations.
Do not be far from us, O Lord.
With you is the fountain of life, and in your light we see light; your steadfast love reaches to the clouds.
Do not be far from us, O Lord.
Come, while the fragrance still hangs in the air; come and worship the servant on his way to the cross.
Do not be far from us, O Lord. Amen.

registers.label: Hybrid
lines: The jar breaks; the house fills with the scent of nard.
Do not be far from us, O Lord.
A bruised reed he will not break; a dim wick he will not quench.
Do not be far from us, O Lord.
With you is the fountain of life; in your light we see light.
Do not be far from us, O Lord.
Come, let us worship the servant on his way.
Do not be far from us, O Lord. Amen.
